analysisPlan.counterbalance: same frozen cyclic baseline order as v0.3
analysisPlan.uncertainty: paired bootstrap interval for latency deltas; exact paired outcomes for success

executorFamily.client: Direct Ollama structured JSON action loop

studyPurpose: Run only the first five existing PLH schedule cells with the live-preflighted JSON-action runtime. Validate real host actions, edits, bounded completion, and external grading; this is not a PLH superiority test.

passSignals: Exactly schedule indices 0-4, paired with B0/B1/B2/B3/P, are present and analyzable.
All five agents completed, with matching JSON runtime/model telemetry and at least one successful host action per cell.
At least one successful write action or a final implementation different from its pre-action version is observed.
No infrastructure failure in any cell or in the checkpoint history.
runtimeValidation.successGate: External correctness and evidence satisfaction are reported separately, not required for executor validation. A completed but incorrect solution remains an analyzable task failure.
runtimeValidation.continueRule: Inspect this batch before authorizing any remaining cells. Do not rerun the same output directory or pool native-tool, one-shot, or interrupted attempts.

preflightEvidence.source: User-supplied console summary, 2026-10-15; full local transcript not independently retrieved.

freezeRules: Runtime source, adapter, native-tool conditions, TaskPacks, graders, ontology, profiles, context mappings, and policy selection are unchanged from the runtime source commit.
The new launcher pins the existing PLH adapter defaults; these are larger budgets/context than the tiny preflight, not another observed success.
Only this new condition, launcher, summary, and regression tests are added. Never edit a frozen condition after inspecting its cells.
Do not mix JSON-action outcomes with native-tool or other executor families. All results remain development-only.
The model tag is pinned; no immutable model-weight digest was supplied in the preflight evidence.
